适用场景（触发）：
- 用户说"帮我整理自传"、"整理我父亲/母亲的人生经历"

触发示例（不限于这些说法）：

- "这些日记想做成一本书"
- "家里有长辈的回忆录手稿，能帮我排版吗"
- "我想把爷爷的故事记录下来"

不适用场景（不要触发）：
- 纯虚构写作、小说创作（这不是创意写作 Skill）
- 简单文档格式转换（用 docx Skill）
- 纯文字润色（无自传/回忆录结构需求）

skills.description: Through fixed aquarium cameras, the system analyzes fish behavior near the water surface, detecting repeated mouth-out-of-water (gasping), rapid mouth opening/closing (fast respiration) and exaggerated operculum (gill cover) movement — classic symptoms of hypoxia or poisoning. When multiple fish exhibit the above behavior simultaneously and the duration exceeds a configurable threshold (default 60 seconds), the system outputs an 'ammonia poisoning or hypoxia risk warning', prompting the user to immediately test water quality, perform water change, or increase aeration. This skill helps take emergency action BEFORE fish die. Application scenarios: home aquariums, public aquariums, aquaculture ponds. The system monitors in real time and pushes alerts the moment fish gasping is detected. Skill features: ammonia poisoning is a common acute emergency in aquariums — by the time it is noticed, fish deaths may have already occurred. AI-based automatic recognition of gasping and abnormal respiration provides emergency warning at the earliest stage, buying time to handle the situation and reduce losses.
